minutes.headline: Select Board set an August 8 special town meeting for solar power purchase agreements, opening the warrant until June 30.
minutes.summary: The board approved a limousine license, a solar net metering amendment extending construction dates, and an August special town meeting with a warrant open until June 30. It cut the Stormwater Task Force from seven to five members and backed a consultant request while asking to see the scope of services first. It made routine appointments, heard committee reports, and went into executive session.

public_comment.topic: Resident and property owner praised the high school music director and the music program.
Stormwater Task Force member spoke in support of hiring a consultant to direct the task force.

A member said the board agreed the August meeting was worth the cost because of the power purchase agreement commitment.
A member said spending above the threshold requires going out to bid with three quotes.
The task force asked for approval of a scope of services so it could solicit quotes up to a stated maximum.
The task force estimated hours of assistance at a stated hourly rate.
A member said the DPW budget already has money for stormwater consultants and the annual report, raising possible overlap.

budget_items.topic: Summer Street design cost and Chapter 90
budget_items.what_was_said: Design cost at 100% is awaited, and the appropriation would likely come from Chapter 90 funds.

decisions.decision: Warrant deadline set at June 30, two days past the proposed week, after a member asked for longer.
Board indicated support for stormwater consultant funding but asked the task force to bring back a more specific scope of services and RFP before it goes out.
Building reuse request for responses was rebid with a July 18 response date.
Next Select Board meeting set for July 5; none next week.

what_happened.line: The Select Board set a special town meeting for August 8 and opened the warrant until June 30, though the vote results were not audible in the recording.
The board approved a limousine license for 53 Chase Road; this vote is recorded as passed.
A motion to approve an amendment to the Nexamp net metering agreement was made and seconded, but the result is not clear in the recording.
A motion to cut the Stormwater Task Force from seven members to five was moved; the outcome was not audible.
The board indicated support for stormwater consultant funding but asked the task force to return with a more specific scope of services and RFP first.

why_it_matters: A special town meeting adds a cost carried by the town budget, mostly taxes, and the board's stated reason was a power purchase agreement commitment that residents may be asked to vote on.

Stormwater consultant spending above the bid threshold needs three quotes, and the DPW budget already holds some stormwater consultant money, so how the two funding sources overlap may affect what residents are asked to fund.
watch_next: The warrant closes Thursday, June 30 at 5:00 pm, ahead of the August 8 special town meeting.
The Stormwater Task Force is to bring back a more specific scope of services and RFP; the next Select Board meeting is July 5.
